title: Variance: how spread out a quantity is

steps.label: Two distributions, same mean
steps.pseudocode: A and B have the same mean.

steps.label: But they are spread differently
steps.pseudocode: Compare how far apart each distribution's values are.

steps.label: Start from the mean
steps.pseudocode: Measure spread relative to the mean of A.

steps.label: Deviations from the mean
steps.pseudocode: deviation = value - mean. Their weighted average is always 0.

steps.label: Square the deviations
steps.pseudocode: Squaring removes the signs and punishes large deviations more.

Compare with B
